# Vendored browser dependencies

KaTeX 0.16.11 is stored locally so mathematical expressions in generated
answers do not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime. The included files are
the minified core renderer, auto-render extension, CSS, WOFF2 fonts, and the
upstream MIT license.

Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex/v/0.16.11>
